capabilities.posture_semantics: M2 v0.1 gated baseline: pipeline implemented (reference calibration, centroid/energy features, contrast quality gate, threshold classification with reject guards). posture=true means the pipeline ran; recordings failing the contrast gate output posture=unknown with calibration_status=invalid for all occupied frames (explicit rejection, not placeholder). See notes.

config.description: M1 v1.2.1 for DEV112P 1dfft parity recordings: (R1) odd/even chirp chains kept separate, each with its own backing; (R2) opening empty-seat calibration for 10 s of valid frames before occupancy judgement is enabled (no 1-frame background lock, no opening false alarm); (R3) F1 background residual normalised by the leakage bin (bin/|bin0|) so the 2.9x site-to-site amplitude spread and the -1.9..-6.2 %/min thermal drift no longer masquerade as occupancy, and the empty-seat decision is driven by the Bin1 micro-motion evidence (detrended frame-to-frame amplitude change, normalised by the opening-empty motion floor). Still-sitting is kept by the 5 s release confirmation; a walk-away releases as soon as the Bin1 micro-motion returns to the empty band for release_frames and the leakage-normalised F1 residual is back within gate, then the empty snapshot is rebuilt from the last 10 s. Config frozen for the C v1.2.1 fix task; v1.2 results (config/M1_dev112p_v0.2.json) are unchanged.

chirp_parity.note: tx_polling=1: odd/even chirps differ ~11x in amplitude (T01 odd ~16200 / even ~1450 counts); averaging them gave the frame-0 +139 counts seed bias.

config.target_count_policy: 1 when presence=1 (single-seat region assumption, documented), 0 when empty, -1 when unknown

region_params.note: Nominal installation values from project plan 5.2 (24-24.25 GHz sweep -> 0.6 m resolution). Replace with measured values after real installation. Coarse-granularity risk documented: plan A region spans only ~3-4 bins.
region_params.bin_conversion: bin_lo = floor(region_m[0] / range_resolution_m); bin_hi = ceil(region_m[1] / range_resolution_m); clip to [0, n_range_bins-1]

notes: v1.2.1 calibration: 53 valid frames over 10.1s; empty motion floor=0.00157 (P20); F1 ref=-48.1 dB
